english.title: Producer / rep fail to finance costs of WEEE collection / treatment / recovery / disposal - private households

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer]_
(B)_[an authorised representative]_

to whom regulation 11(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 applied, failed to finance the costs of the collection, treatment, recovery and environmentally sound disposal of **(..SPECIFY THE AMOUNT OF WEEE IN TONNES..), being the amount calculated by the appropriate authority in accordance with regulation 11(3) of those regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 11(2), 90(1)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a producer/authorised representative to whom regulation 11(1) applied
failed to finance costs of collection, treatment, recovery and environmentally sound disposal of WEEE

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes: See regulation 2 for definitions of 'producer', 'authorised representative' and 'WEEE'
